data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 were GBP 81.142m. During 2016 the syndicate experienced a prior-year favourable run-off deviation of GBP 1.1m, arising wholly from reserve movements on the 2012 and 2013 years under Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003. The movement is reported as a prior-year release and is attributable to improved claims development and adjustments related to reinsurance recoveries under the quota share arrangements.

improvement in the loss ratio is primarily due to the change in contract terms on the XL Catlin Syndicate 2003 quota share contract in 2015

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement extracted from Note 9's narrative which states a GBP 1.1m favourable run-off deviation. The note gives an explicit amount but does not label it clearly as 'gross' or 'net of reinsurance' in the sentence; the balance sheet shows gross claims outstanding figures. No per-LOB prior-year movement amounts are provided. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 30) which could be used to cross-check, but the explicit prior-year movement narrative was used as the primary source.
